# LLM evals (generated by `eos scaffold llm-evals`; yours to edit)

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `prompts/*.prompt.md` | Versioned prompt files: frontmatter (`id`, `version`, `model`, `owner`, `evals`, `max_output_tokens`, `inputs`, `untrusted`) + the prompt text. `eos llm check` lints them; bump `version` on every change. |
| `evals/llm/cases.jsonl` | One case per line: `id`, `prompt`, `vars`, `expect` (code graders: `contains`, `contains_any`, `not_contains`, `regex`, `max_chars`, `json_keys`), `tags` (`lang:fr`, `lang:en`, `safety`, …), optional `fake_output`. |
| `evals/llm/run_evals.py` | Calls the model with the prompt's pinned settings, grades with code, writes `results.json` (no outputs unless `--keep-outputs`). `--fake` grades `fake_output` without calls. |
| `evals/llm/gate.json` | Thresholds: `min_pass_rate`, `min_by_tag`, `max_drop` vs baseline, `min_cases`. |
| `evals/llm/baseline.json` | Written by `eos llm gate --update` after a reviewed passing run. Commit it in its own change. |
| `.github/workflows/llm-evals.yml` | PRs touching prompts/evals + nightly: `eos llm check`, the evals (capped calls, `OPENAI_API_KEY` secret), `eos llm gate`. |
| `.semgrep/eos-llm.yml` | Model output into exec/SQL/HTML, AI keys in client bundles, missing token caps and timeouts. |

Workflow: edit a prompt → bump `version` → `python evals/llm/run_evals.py` → `python3 .eos/bin/eos.py llm gate`
→ open the PR (CI repeats both). Add a case for every production failure you fix (redact personal data first).

Grow the set to at least 30–50 cases per prompt before trusting the thresholds, with native-speaker review of the
French cases. Model-graded criteria (LLM-as-judge) need a rubric and a check against human labels first.
Refs: `.eos/packs/ref/llm/evals-in-production.md`, `.eos/packs/ref/testing/llm-evals.md`.
